scientificPrior.reference: Small & Tse, Chaos 22 (2012), Predicting the outcome of roulette
scientificPrior.finding: Initial ball/wheel position, velocity and acceleration can provide sufficient predictive information for positive expected return on a physical European roulette wheel; reported experimental expected return at least 18% in their setup.
